'''Corellian Reserve''' was a rare, expensive [[Corellian brandy/Legends|Corellian brandy]]. It had a golden color. The [[Red Ronto]] kept a few bottles in stock to serve [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
